packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Proven experience in biomass handling systems for gasification; reference plant operating > 2 years
packages.technical_documents_required: General arrangement drawings, capacity calculations, motor power, material selection for abrasion resistance
packages.inspection_requirements: Factory acceptance test for conveying system; run test at vendor shop
packages.acceptance_tests: 168-hour continuous run at design capacity with target feedstock

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Experience with high-moisture biomass drying; references for rotary/fluidised bed dryers on similar feedstock
packages.technical_documents_required: Heat and mass balance, drying curves, emissions from dryer, safety interlocks
packages.inspection_requirements: Shop inspection of drum/rotor; motor performance test
packages.acceptance_tests: Moisture reduction from design inlet to outlet at rated throughput

packages.package_name: Gasifier (including feed system, refractory, syngas quench)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Licensed gasification technology with at least 3 reference plants > 50% of proposed capacity; experience with target feedstock type
packages.technical_documents_required: Process design package, P&IDs, equipment drawings, refractory specification, oxidant injection design
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise inspection: refractory installation, pressure parts welding, NDT of critical welds; performance test witnessed
packages.acceptance_tests: 72-hour continuous run at nameplate capacity within guaranteed syngas composition and cold gas efficiency

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Proven ASU supplier with references at or above required scale; experience with biomass gasification integration
packages.technical_documents_required: Process description, purity guarantee, power consumption guarantee, delivery pressure, liquid oxygen backup capacity
packages.inspection_requirements: Shop inspection of cold box; control system FAT; performance test at site
packages.acceptance_tests: Oxygen purity and flow at design conditions; specific power consumption within guarantee

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Experience with syngas cooling in dirty gas service (tar-containing); references for high-temperature heat recovery
packages.technical_documents_required: Thermal design (duty, approach, turndown), materials for corrosion/erosion resistance, soot blowing system
packages.inspection_requirements: Hydrotest at shop; welding NDT; tube-to-tubesheet joint inspection
packages.acceptance_tests: Steam generation rate and outlet syngas temperature at design conditions

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Proven in biomass syngas service; filter element life > 12 months in similar service
packages.technical_documents_required: Filter area, material (temperature rating), pulse-jet cleaning design, pressure drop at design flow
packages.inspection_requirements: Shop inspection of housing; filter element quality check; pressure test
packages.acceptance_tests: Outlet particulates < 5 mg/Nm³ at design conditions

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Licensed tar reforming technology with reference at similar or larger scale; catalyst life and regeneration strategy
packages.technical_documents_required: Process design, catalyst volume, operating temperature/pressure, steam/carbon ratio
packages.inspection_requirements: Reformer tube/weld NDT; catalyst supplier certificate; refractory installation inspection
packages.acceptance_tests: Outlet tar < 10 mg/Nm³ at design throughput; catalyst activity after 1000 hours

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Proven in syngas cleanup for particulate and soluble gas removal
packages.technical_documents_required: Scrubber design (L/G ratio, pressure drop), liquid circulation pump, mist eliminator, blowdown treatment
packages.inspection_requirements: Shop hydrotest; internal inspection of spray nozzles and packing
packages.acceptance_tests: Outlet particulates < 20 mg/Nm³; outlet temperature within spec

packages.package_name: Acid gas removal system (amine or Selexol)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Licensed AGR technology with references in syngas; solvent selection appropriate for CO2/H2S ratio
packages.technical_documents_required: Process description, solvent specification, regeneration system design, reboiler duty, solvent losses
packages.inspection_requirements: Shop inspection of absorber/regenerator columns; packing installation supervision
packages.acceptance_tests: Outlet H2S < 0.1 ppmv; CO2 removal rate within spec; solvent consumption per guarantee

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Design and supply of guard beds with proven sorbent materials for sulfur and chlorine polishing
packages.technical_documents_required: Vessel design (pressure/temperature), sorbent volume, bed geometry, inlet/outlet distributors
packages.inspection_requirements: Shop pressure test; internal distributor inspection
packages.acceptance_tests: Outlet S < 0.1 ppmv, Cl < 1 ppmv; pressure drop at design flow

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Centrifugal or reciprocating compressor supplier with syngas service references; certified for required discharge pressure
packages.technical_documents_required: Compressor curve, driver sizing, seal system (dry gas or oil), interstage cooling, vibration monitoring
packages.inspection_requirements: Mechanical run test at vendor shop; performance test per API 617 or 618
packages.acceptance_tests: Flow and discharge pressure at design; power consumption within guarantee

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Licensed methanol synthesis technology with 5+ references at similar scale; boiling water reactor or isothermal experience
packages.technical_documents_required: Reactor mechanical design (pressure, temperature), catalyst bed design, heat removal system, startup heater
packages.inspection_requirements: Shop hydrotest; catalyst basket fit check; weld NDT; heat exchanger tube test
packages.acceptance_tests: Methanol production rate; conversion per pass; heat removal capacity; outlet temperature profile

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Catalyst supplier with proven performance at 5+ commercial methanol plants; lifetime guarantee offered
packages.technical_documents_required: Catalyst specification, activation/reduction procedure, loading instructions, expected lifetime, activity curves
packages.inspection_requirements: Batch quality certificate; particle size distribution; crush strength test
packages.acceptance_tests: Catalyst performance during 72-hour performance guarantee run of methanol loop

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Column supplier with experience in methanol/water distillation; tray or packing design for high-purity methanol
packages.technical_documents_required: Column hydraulic design, tray/packing specification, reboiler and condenser duty, pressure drop, product spec target
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise shop inspection; tray installation tolerances; packing pressure drop test
packages.acceptance_tests: Product methanol purity ≥ 99.85 wt%; ethanol < 50 ppm; other impurities per IMPCA spec

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: TEMA-type exchanger manufacturer with experience in high-pressure and high-temperature service
packages.technical_documents_required: Thermal design sheets (HTRI/HTFS), mechanical datasheets, material selection, tube bundle drawing
packages.inspection_requirements: Hydrotest; tube expansion inspection; NDT of welds
packages.acceptance_tests: Thermal performance within 5% of guarantee at design conditions

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Tank fabricator with API 620 or 650 experience; methanol service reference required; internal floating roof supplier if applicable
packages.technical_documents_required: Tank design (diameter, height, material), roof type, seal system, fire protection (foam), blanketing system
packages.inspection_requirements: Bottom/floor inspection, shell plate NDT, hydrotest, floating roof tightness test
packages.acceptance_tests: Tank tightness, vapour recovery efficiency, foam system coverage

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Methanol loading system supplier with vapour recovery and safety interlock experience
packages.technical_documents_required: Loading arm design, flow meter, vapour return, grounding system, emergency shutdown, breakaway coupling
packages.inspection_requirements: Factory test of loading arm; flow meter calibration certificate
packages.acceptance_tests: Loading rate at design; vapour recovery efficiency; shutdown system function test

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Flare supplier with biomass syngas and methanol off-gas experience; compliance with local emission standards
packages.technical_documents_required: Flare design (height, diameter, tip type), purge gas rate, pilot system, radiation contours, knockout drum
packages.inspection_requirements: Shop inspection of flare tip, pilot burner, KO drum; sub-supplier certificates for instrumentation
packages.acceptance_tests: Destruction efficiency ≥ 99%; radiation within allowable limits; noise within permit

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: DCS supplier with references in process industries (chemical/petrochemical); SIL-rated logic solver for safety functions
packages.technical_documents_required: System architecture, I/O list, network topology, HMI philosophy, alarm management, historian specification
packages.inspection_requirements: Factory acceptance test (FAT) with full system simulation; site acceptance test (SAT) after installation
packages.acceptance_tests: All control loops functional; alarm and interlogics verified; historian data collection operational

packages.package_name: Emergency shutdown (ESD) and fire & gas system
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: SIL-rated system supplier; experience in oil/gas or chemical sector; IEC 61508 certified
packages.technical_documents_required: SIL determination, logic diagrams, cause-and-effect matrix, fire/gas detector layout, voting philosophy
packages.inspection_requirements: FAT of logic solver; SAT of field device testing; cause-and-effect matrix testing
packages.acceptance_tests: All ESD levels (plant, unit, equipment) functional; fire/gas detection coverage validated

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Supplier of GC, moisture analyser, Karl Fischer titrator, density meter; experience with methanol quality testing
packages.technical_documents_required: Instrument specification (detection limits, range, precision), calibration standards, installation requirements
packages.inspection_requirements: Factory calibration certificate; installation and commissioning support
packages.acceptance_tests: Method validation against IMPCA reference standards; repeatability within limits

packages.package_name: Cooling tower and cooling water system
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Cooling tower supplier with references in process industry; ambient temperature design based on site conditions
packages.technical_documents_required: Thermal design (approach, range, wet bulb), tower type (induced/forced draft), fill specification, drift eliminators
packages.inspection_requirements: Factory test of fan/motor assembly; drift test during commissioning
packages.acceptance_tests: Cooling water temperature at design approach/range; fan power within guarantee

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Water treatment supplier with experience in chemical/petrochemical plants; zero-liquid-discharge capability if required
packages.technical_documents_required: Raw water analysis, treatment process design (RO/EDI/IX), product water specification, waste stream analysis
packages.inspection_requirements: Shop inspection of RO skids; membrane quality certificate; control system FAT
packages.acceptance_tests: Product water quality (conductivity, silica, TOC) within spec; recovery rate per design

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Package boiler supplier with experience in biomass plant steam systems; IBR certified design
packages.technical_documents_required: Boiler design (steam pressure, temperature, capacity), fuel (syngas/off-gas/start-up fuel), economiser design
packages.inspection_requirements: IBR inspection during fabrication; hydrotest; safety valve testing
packages.acceptance_tests: Steam generation rate and quality at design conditions; boiler efficiency within guarantee
